evidence.detail: The class owns exactly two integer values interpreted as maximum and current progress. Its percentage method returns current * 100 / maximum, with the maximum clamped to at least 1 by the setter.
paintComponent computes current * width / maximum, paints the unfilled segment with a darker derived background color, then paints the filled segment from x=0 using the foreground color.
The JPanel is configured as a thin 4-pixel-high component with unbounded maximum width, matching a reusable horizontal progress bar rather than a feature-specific panel.

The only project class referencing this component is R14 TradingPostListingPanel. That panel sets foreground color plus maximum/current listing values, queries the percentage for tooltip text, and places the component at BorderLayout.SOUTH.

candidates.note: ProgressBar is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for a generic horizontal progress component. The implementation is feature-agnostic even though exact v308 currently has one live consumer in TradingPostListingPanel. Confidence is 0.999.
